recommendation: Keep the FHIR-26390 fix. Process FHIR-57354 separately when Resolved - change required issues are in scope, because that later decision targets the Bundle.entry.resource guardrail and should not reintroduce stale blanket Parameters prohibition language.
issue_request: FHIR-26390 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked FHIR-I to avoid treating FHIR-26368 as a blanket permission for Parameters everywhere Resource or Reference(Any) appears, and instead to permit Parameters only in explicitly described limited cases and named elements.
initial_application: Historical Jira-tagged commits applied the main request: e6dd5ff updated Parameters usage notes and StructureDefinition text, ce61932 updated Bundle.entry.resource, 0003f88 updated MessageHeader.focus, 0b644b1 updated TestScript.fixture.resource, 6bf1629 updated AuditEvent.entity.what, and 91f576c updated DomainResource.contained. Current source still retained a contradictory Parameters Boundaries sentence saying the resource had no other use than operation parameters, and the root Parameters definition omitted the exception qualifier.
additional_context: FHIR-26368 was the original Published messaging request; the 2020 Zulip thread and FHIR-I minutes show the accepted direction was limited explicit allowances, not a blanket prohibition or blanket permission. FHIR-57354 is a later Resolved - change required request to remove only the Bundle.entry.resource guardrail, but it is outside this default Applied/Published source-edit scope and was not decided here.
reconciliation: Changed source/parameters/parameters-introduction.xml so Boundaries and Relationships now says non-operation Parameters use is limited to the cases described above, and changed source/parameters/structuredefinition-Parameters.xml so the root Parameters definition includes the same exception qualifier as the resource description.
source_changes: source/parameters/parameters-introduction.xml: replaced the stale 'no other use than for operation parameters' boundary sentence with limited-use wording tied to the cases described above.
source/parameters/structuredefinition-Parameters.xml: added the exception qualifier to the root Parameters definition so the reference prohibition is not presented as absolute.

related_jiras.note: Original Published request to allow Parameters in messaging; FHIR-26390 narrowed its application into explicit limited allowances.
2026 Resolved - change required request to remove the Bundle.entry.resource Parameters guardrail; not Applied/Published and not in this run's source-edit scope.
